adjudication.evidence: P1 (549–550) is a single-day spike in U with no sustained shift or return; P2 (558–560) shows a brief E/N dip but no opposing return and is followed by a large permanent step at 563; P3 (563–602) coincides with the onset of a permanent step (confirmed by residual continuity after subtraction) and lacks a return—U recovers only partially and slowly, not as a symmetric offset. No candidate exhibits a sustained platform with clear opposing onset/return across axes. Physical motion (trend) continues uninterrupted through all intervals.
